package lanes

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/windshare/windshare/core/transfer/fault"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	"github.com/windshare/windshare/core/content/records"
	"github.com/windshare/windshare/core/session/protocolsession"
)

func TestResearchExhaustedDirectRouteDoesNotWaitForForbiddenRelay(t *testing.T) {
	for _, includeRelay := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "direct-only"
		if includeRelay {
			name = "direct-with-policy-forbidden-relay"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				set, err := New(Config{ProtocolSessionID: protocolsession.ProtocolSessionID{1}, ContentRoutePolicy: ContentRouteDirectOnly})
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				defer set.Close()
				descriptor := transferDescriptor(t, 1)
				demand := validDemand(t, descriptor, 0)
				if err := set.Add(Identity{ID: 2, Epoch: 1}, RouteDirect, laneFunction(func(context.Context, Demand) (records.BlockRecord, error) {
					pause, _ := fault.NewSession(fault.ScopeOutputPause, fault.SessionTransport)
					return records.BlockRecord{}, NewDemandReassignableAfterRetirement(fault.Wrap(pause, errors.New("block fragment inactivity")))
				})); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if includeRelay {
					if err := set.Add(Identity{ID: 1}, RouteRelay, laneFunction(func(context.Context, Demand) (records.BlockRecord, error) {
						t.Error("permanently forbidden relay carried content")
						return records.BlockRecord{}, nil
					})); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
				defer cancel()
				done := make(chan error, 1)
				go func() {
					_, err := set.Fetch(ctx, Request{Demand: demand, Validate: validateTransferRecord(demand)})
					done <- err
				}()
				synctest.Wait()
				time.Sleep(3 * time.Minute)
				synctest.Wait()
				select {
				case err := <-done:
					if err == nil {
						t.Error("exhausted route unexpectedly succeeded")
					}
					t.Logf("exhaustion surfaced: %v", err)
				default:
					t.Errorf("no result after three virtual minutes; demand=%+v", set.SchedulingDemand())
					cancel()
					synctest.Wait()
					<-done
				}
			})
		})
	}
}
